build_InputBlock: build an InputBlock module to featurize molecular graph input data into edge and global embeddings
create_atomic_embedding: create an atomic number embedding layer using nn.Embedding with uniform initialization for molecular elements
create_charge_spin_embedding: create charge and spin embeddings using ChgSpinEmbedding for molecular graph charge and spin features
run_forward_InputBlock: run the InputBlock forward pass to compute neighbor embeddings from GraphAttentionData input
review_InputBlock_forward: review the InputBlock forward method that combines atomic, direction, charge, and spin embeddings into neighbor embeddings
